anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: Three facts moved from fails to holds even though none were expected to move, and no fact that Before kept was lost. Before treated the clean checkout as an empty uncommitted run ("done empty", "no files to check"), so it named neither hash, gave no ancestry reason and ended as empty. After's split of no-argument runs after the single status observation routes a clean checkout to unpushed selection, and its divergent-ancestry refusal produces the stuck stop. That stop names both full hashes, says origin/main is not an ancestor of HEAD, explains that an amend must not rewrite a commit the remote has moved past, presents no card or Fix/Ignore choice, and states that no checks or writes ran. The run folder is named in both outputs. To keep this, preserve the wording that makes the refusal state both commit ids, the ancestry reason tied to amend delivery, and the run folder line. Two small tightenings would help: have the stop call the run folder retained explicitly, and keep the "reconcile, then run again" advice clearly phrased as a new run so it is never read as continuing this one. The Results block is mostly "none" lines for a run that stopped at admission and could be shortened for this stop without affecting any fact.
